description: Take a legal reference off an issue or a wiki page, by the 'id' list_legal_references gave it — as «Remove» in the block «Legal acts» does. A reference read from words that still stand in the text is kept as a «no» ('keptAsRefused' true, its state 'rejected'), so the next save does not put it back; one put by hand with no words of its own is deleted. Requires permission to edit the text it stands in.
name: remove_legal_reference
